test.name: Unresolved identity conflict blocks proof-conclusion when research stopped with blocked_by_conflict (direct-agent arm)
test.description: In flynn-conflict-proof-block, q_001 has search_stop.stopped_because set to 'blocked_by_conflict' — research-exhaustiveness already ran and found the birthplace conflict (c_001: Ireland vs. Pennsylvania) unresolved. c_001.blocks_question_ids includes q_001 and c_001.status is 'unresolved'. When proof-conclusion is asked to conclude q_001, the conflict gate must hard-block: the birthplace conflict is identity-scoped (it goes to whether the census records and the death certificate describe the same Patrick Flynn), so the skill must decline to write a proof_summaries entry and route to conflict-resolution. Writing any proof tier — even possible — is a FAIL.

input.delegation:

projectPath: <workspace>

judge_context: c_001 (birthplace: Ireland vs. Pennsylvania) is status 'unresolved' and blocks_question_ids includes 'q_001'. This is the conflict gate trigger.

The birthplace conflict is identity-scoped: birthplace goes to whether the 1850/1860 census entries and the 1908 death certificate describe the same Patrick Flynn. Per the proof-conclusion agent rules, an unresolved identity conflict hard-blocks ALL tiers.
Must NOT call research_append to write a proof_summaries entry. Any call that writes proof_summaries is a FAIL.
Must route to conflict-resolution (name the skill or agent) and explain that c_001 must be resolved before a conclusion can be written.
Should name c_001 specifically and describe the birthplace dispute (Ireland vs. Pennsylvania) as the blocker.
The fact that q_001.search_stop.stopped_because is 'blocked_by_conflict' should be consistent with the finding — the skill recognizes why research-exhaustiveness already recorded a block.
